admission_rule: A cell is admitted when its registered run directory holds one complete, unconflicted four-draw fixed-seed sampled K=8 evaluation at the target step. Admission is decided from coverage alone, before any metric is read, and a cell that fails it is recorded as a gap with its reason. The untrained step is admitted the same way and separately, so a level keeps a sound endpoint when its frozen checkpoint could not be measured.

pmd_definition.aggregation: pooled over a checkpoint's four admitted draws, unweighted mean over defined prompts
pmd_definition.estimator: PCMD = 1 - sum_m n_m (n_m - 1) / (K (K - 1)) over a prompt's verified responses
